1: // Neon Escape: simple top‑down endless runner
2: // Canvas with id="game" is expected in the HTML.
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   // audio setup
8:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
9:   const playBeep = (freq, dur) => {
10:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
11:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
12:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
13:     osc.type = 'sine';
14:     osc.connect(gain);
15:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
16:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, audioCtx.currentTime);
17:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
18:     osc.start();
19:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + dur);
20:   };
21:   // ensure audio context is resumed on first interaction
22:   const resumeAudio = () => { if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume(); };
23:   window.addEventListener('keydown', resumeAudio);
24: 
25:   // full‑screen canvas
26:   const resize = () => {
27:     canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
28:     canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
29:     // generate starfield for background
30:     stars.length = 0;
31:     const STAR_COUNT = 120;
32:     for (let i = 0; i < STAR_COUNT; i++) {
33:       stars.push({
34:         x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
35:         y: Math.random() * canvas.height,
36:         size: Math.random() * 2 + 0.5,
37:         opacity: Math.random() * 0.6 + 0.4,
38:       });
39:     }
40:   };
41:   resize();
42:   window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
43: 
44:   // player state
45:   const player = {
46:     x: canvas.width / 2,
47:     y: canvas.height / 2,
48:     radius: 8,
49:     speed: 2.5,
50:     angle: 0, // radians, 0 = up
51:     color: '#0ff',
52:   };
53: 
54:   // input handling (left/right rotate)
55:   const keys = { ArrowLeft: false, ArrowRight: false, a: false, d: false };
56:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.key in keys) keys[e.key] = true; });
57:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { if (e.key in keys) keys[e.key] = false; });
58: 
59:   // obstacles – simple moving rectangles (bars) and spikes (triangles)
60:   const obstacles = [];
61:   const OBSTACLE_SPACING = 120; // distance between generated columns
62:   let lastObstacleY = -OBSTACLE_SPACING;
63:   // starfield for background
64:   const stars = [];
65:   // trail for player motion blur
66:   const trail = [];
67:   const MAX_TRAIL = 20;
68: 
69: 
70:   // score tracking
71:   let distance = 0;
72:   let gameOver = false;
73: 
74:   // utility helpers
75:   const rand = (a, b) => Math.random() * (b - a) + a;
76:   const degToRad = deg => deg * Math.PI / 180;
77: 
78:   // generate a column of obstacles at a given y offset (relative to player forward movement)
79:   const generateObstacles = () => {
80:     // create a random gap for the player to pass through
81:     const gapWidth = 80; // pixels
82:     const gapX = rand(gapWidth, canvas.width - gapWidth);
83:     // left bar
84:     obstacles.push({
85:       type: 'bar',
86:       x: 0,
87:       y: lastObstacleY,
88:       w: gapX - gapWidth / 2,
89:       h: 20,
90:     });
91:     // right bar
92:     obstacles.push({
93:       type: 'bar',
94:       x: gapX + gapWidth / 2,
95:       y: lastObstacleY,
96:       w: canvas.width - (gapX + gapWidth / 2),
97:       h: 20,
98:     });
99:     // occasional spikes (triangle) inside the gap
100:     if (Math.random() < 0.3) {
101:       const spikeSize = 12;
102:       obstacles.push({
103:         type: 'spike',
104:         x: gapX,
105:         y: lastObstacleY - spikeSize,
106:         size: spikeSize,
107:       });
108:     }
109:     lastObstacleY -= OBSTACLE_SPACING;
110:   };
111: 
112:   // initial obstacles
113:   for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) generateObstacles();
114: 
115:   // collision detection
116:   const checkCollision = () => {
117:     // canvas edge
118:     if (
119:       player.x - player.radius < 0 ||
120:       player.x + player.radius > canvas.width ||
121:       player.y - player.radius < 0 ||
122:       player.y + player.radius > canvas.height
123:     ) {
124:       return true;
125:     }
126:     // obstacles
127:     for (const o of obstacles) {
128:       if (o.type === 'bar') {
129:         // simple AABB vs circle
130:         const dx = Math.max(o.x - player.x, 0, player.x - (o.x + o.w));
131:         const dy = Math.max(o.y - player.y, 0, player.y - (o.y + o.h));
132:         if (dx * dx + dy * dy < player.radius * player.radius) return true;
133:       } else if (o.type === 'spike') {
134:         // point‑in‑triangle test (spike points upward)
135:         const { x, y, size } = o;
136:         const p0 = { x, y };
137:         const p1 = { x: x - size, y: y + size };
138:         const p2 = { x: x + size, y: y + size };
139:         const area = (p0.x - p2.x) * (p1.y - p2.y) - (p1.x - p2.x) * (p0.y - p2.y);
140:         const s = ((p0.x - p2.x) * (player.y - p2.y) - (player.x - p2.x) * (p0.y - p2.y)) / area;
141:         const t = ((player.x - p2.x) * (p1.y - p2.y) - (player.x - p2.x) * (p1.x - p2.x)) / area;
142:         if (s >= 0 && t >= 0 && s + t <= 1) return true;
143:       }
144:     }
145:     return false;
146:   };
147: 
148:   // main loop
149:   const loop = () => {
150:     if (gameOver) {
151:       // display game over
152:       ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
153:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
154:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
155:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
156:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
157:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
158:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
159:       ctx.fillText(`Distance: ${Math.floor(distance)}`, canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 + 40);
160:       return;
161:     }
162: 
163:     // handle rotation input
164:     if (keys.ArrowLeft || keys.a) {
165:       player.angle -= degToRad(2);
166:       playBeep(300, 0.05);
167:     }
168:     if (keys.ArrowRight || keys.d) {
169:       player.angle += degToRad(2);
170:       playBeep(400, 0.05);
171:     }
172: 
173:   // move player forward in its current direction
174:   player.x += Math.sin(player.angle) * player.speed;
175:   player.y -= Math.cos(player.angle) * player.speed; // canvas y grows downwards
176: 
177:   // update trail for motion blur effect
178:   trail.push({ x: player.x, y: player.y, alpha: 1 });
179:   if (trail.length > MAX_TRAIL) trail.shift();
180: 
181: 
182:     // shift obstacles opposite to player movement to create illusion of forward motion
183:     const dy = player.speed; // vertical shift (since player moves upward in game space)
184:     for (const o of obstacles) o.y += dy;
185:     distance += player.speed;
186: 
187:     // generate new obstacles when needed
188:     while (lastObstacleY > -canvas.height) generateObstacles();
189: 
190:     // remove off‑screen obstacles
191:     while (obstacles.length && obstacles[0].y > canvas.height) obstacles.shift();
192: 
193:     // collision check
194:     if (checkCollision()) {
195:       playBeep(150, 0.3);
196:       gameOver = true;
197:     }
198: 
199:   // draw background with neon gradient
200:   const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
201:   bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#001');
202:   bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#000');
203:   ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
204:   ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
205: 
206:   // draw stars (twinkling background)
207:   ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
208:   for (const s of stars) {
209:     s.y += player.speed * 0.5; // slower than player for parallax
210:     if (s.y > canvas.height) {
211:       s.y = 0;
212:       s.x = Math.random() * canvas.width;
213:     }
214:     ctx.globalAlpha = s.opacity;
215:     ctx.beginPath();
216:     ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
217:     ctx.fill();
218:   }
219:   ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
220: 
221: 
222:     // draw obstacles with neon glow
223:     ctx.shadowColor = '#f0f';
224:     ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
225:     ctx.fillStyle = '#f0f';
226:     for (const o of obstacles) {
227:       if (o.type === 'bar') {
228:         ctx.fillRect(o.x, o.y, o.w, o.h);
229:       } else if (o.type === 'spike') {
230:         ctx.beginPath();
231:         ctx.moveTo(o.x, o.y);
232:         ctx.lineTo(o.x - o.size, o.y + o.size);
233:         ctx.lineTo(o.x + o.size, o.y + o.size);
234:         ctx.closePath();
235:         ctx.fill();
236:       }
237:     }
238:     ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
239:     // draw motion trail for player
240:     ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';
241:     for (let i = 0; i < trail.length; i++) {
242:       const t = trail[i];
243:       const alpha = (i + 1) / trail.length;
244:       ctx.globalAlpha = alpha * 0.6;
245:       ctx.fillStyle = player.color;
246:       ctx.beginPath();
247:       ctx.arc(t.x, t.y, player.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
248:       ctx.fill();
249:     }
250:     ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
251:     ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
252: 
253:     // draw player (glowing dot)
254:     ctx.fillStyle = player.color;
255:     ctx.beginPath();
256:     ctx.arc(player.x, player.y, player.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
257:     ctx.fill();
258:     // neon glow effect
259:     ctx.shadowColor = player.color;
260:     ctx.shadowBlur = 12;
261:     ctx.beginPath();
262:     ctx.arc(player.x, player.y, player.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
263:     ctx.fill();
264:     ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
265: 
266:     // draw score
267:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
268:     ctx.font = '18px sans-serif';
269:     ctx.textAlign = 'left';
270:     ctx.fillText(`Distance: ${Math.floor(distance)}`, 10, 30);
271: 
272:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
273:   };
274: 
275:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
276: })();
